critical_code_review_comments: transportation_search.py (421 lines) is well-bounded and adheres to composer doctrine — pure fanout over existing collections (transport_persons, carriers, transport_trucks, dispatch_assignments, projects, carrier_documents, driver_documents, transport_orientation_modules, transport_orientation_certificates, transport_action_items). No new collection, no new business logic.
_safe_regex correctly escapes user input with re.escape and caps to MAX_QUERY=80 chars before regex projection — safe against ReDoS and regex-injection.
asyncio.gather with 4s timeout prevents long fanouts from blocking the request.
Audit row writes ONLY query_prefix (first 3 chars) + query_length — verified live that full query text never appears in audit_events row (PII-safe).
_types_for_role RBAC map is strict and explicit; default-deny (empty set → 403). HR/Shop/FL/Safety scopes are correctly tight.
Per-result envelope (type/title/subtitle/status/source/route/reason/metadata) is uniform across all 8 fanouts — clean contract.
Every result has a non-empty deep-link route starting with `/admin/transportation/...` or `/pm/project/{pn}`.
